blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Education Secretary Sonny Angara urged technology and social media companies to strengthen age-verification measures and remove online content that promotes violence, as the government seeks to address a series of deadly school shootings and the growing threat of online radicalization among young learners. The call comes following three fatal school shootings in the country within a span of three months: at San Jose National High School in Tacloban City in June, Ateneo de Zamboanga University in August, and Banga National High School in South Cotabato in September.
